PostSilo is a privacy-first company building an AI automation platform for professional services firms that handle sensitive, high-volume client work. We're hiring two founding engineers to take the product from serving its initial customers to one that scales to hundreds of firms.

Position 1: Founding Engineer, Data & Retrieval

Position 2: Founding Engineer, AI Systems & Infrastructure

Type: Full Time - USA (Remote)

Full details of each role can be found at: https://postsilo.ai/resources/
